entries.zh: 走邪路；行暗路（比喻步入歧途、行恶事）
entries.en: to walk an evil/crooked path; to go astray morally

entries.zh: 东奔西走；四处行走
entries.en: to go here and there, to wander about

entries.zh: 上上下下地走；来往奔走
entries.en: to go up and down, to move back and forth

entries.zh: 走路不偏离正路；行不背路（沿正道而行，不走偏）
entries.en: to walk without straying from the road; not to depart from the right path
entries.notes: 西语词头'no apartar'（不离开）与汉字'行不箸路'对应，'箸'疑为'著/着'，取不背离道路之义

entries.zh: 迷路；走到没有路的地方（比喻迷失方向、堕落）
entries.en: to lose one's way, to go astray; to be lost (morally wandering)
entries.notes: 西语'moralix'似为 moralmente（道德上）之略，兼指道德迷失；'行無路去'即走入无路之处

entries.zh: 走偏僻一边；行于僻静小路
entries.en: to walk aside on a secluded path; to go off to one side
entries.notes: 西语 afora desejados 为转写残损，依汉字'行僻一邊'取偏行僻路之义

entries.zh: 行江海之人；出外闯荡江湖者（背井离乡讨生活的人）
entries.en: one who travels rivers and seas; one who leaves home to seek his living
entries.notes: 西语词头转写残损（'el ma×cader…'难以完全解读），主要依'行江海人'与出外谋生语境释义

entries.zh: 行江湖之人；闯荡江湖的游子、漂泊者
entries.en: a wanderer of rivers and lakes; an itinerant adventurer
entries.notes: 西语词头残损，依汉字'行江湖人'释义；江海/江湖二条相承

entries.zh: 行海；航海
entries.en: to travel by sea, to sail

entries.zh: 行直；走直路（正直而行）
entries.en: to walk the straight road; to go straight
entries.notes: 西语'camino del rayo'（雷电之路）转写存疑，依汉字'行 直'取直路/正直之义

entries.zh: 行旅；旅行、赶路
entries.en: to travel, to journey

entries.zh: 趋；快步走、疾行
entries.en: to hasten, to walk quickly

entries.zh: 趋走；疾步奔走
entries.en: to hurry along, to walk hastily

entries.zh: 趋奉；趋前奉承、殷勤侍奉
entries.en: to attend obsequiously, to serve eagerly; to fawn

entries.zh: 趋赶；急忙赶路、赶忙
entries.en: to hurry, to hasten with great haste

entries.zh: 趮；急躁、性急（〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕）
entries.en: hasty, impetuous; to act rashly (damaged entry, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字'趮'疑为'躁'，闽南语音写'sô po [残]'有污损难辨成分，官话栏仅存一字，材料不足

entries.zh: 转；转动、旋转
entries.en: to turn, to rotate
entries.notes: 依汉字'轉'与西语'andar la rueda'（轮转）释义；闽南语音写含多余音节'tī'，语义归属存疑

entries.zh: 转过；转过身、绕过
entries.en: to turn past, to go around, to turn over

entries.zh: 转换；转换、更换、交替
entries.en: to exchange, to convert, to alternate

entries.zh: 泉涌；汁液沸腾涌出（〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕）
entries.en: to bubble up, to boil over (of juices); (damaged entry, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字'泉'疑为'煮'，单字对应西语'juices bubbling'，字义与西语义项不完全吻合

entries.zh: 甭；摆架子、神气活现（〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕）
entries.en: to strut, to show off (damaged entry, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字'甭'疑为'甬'，西语'andar agatos'（昂首阔步）与闽南语音写 Bōn 难以互证，材料不足

entries.zh: 甭甭；神气十足、大摇大摆（〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕）
entries.en: to strut about, to swagger (damaged entry, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 承上条，'甭'疑为'甬'，叠用表神气之态；闽南语 po 音与汉字对应存疑
